description: Finds the registry package for a library name ("next.js" -> npm:next, "pytorch" -> pypi:torch) and returns ids for get-docs, with the newest version that has no known advisories (safe) and a verdict. Skip it when you know the registry name: get-docs takes "npm:next" or "pypi:requests" directly, and check-packages takes plain names.

ecosystem.description: npm, pypi, cargo, go, maven, nuget, rubygems or composer, when you know it.

query.description: What you want to do with it; also used to guess the language.

name: find-library
title: Find a library (with security verdict)
